sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

Petition under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 has been preferred on behalf of the petitioners for quashing of FIR No. 0069/2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at P.S.: Jaffarpur Kalan and proceedings emanating therefrom.
Chargesheet has been filed under Sections 498A/406/34/506 IPC.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner No. 1 and respondent No. 2 are residing together and are unable to appear due to a death in near relations.
This is a digitally signed order.
